items.title: The CISO’s evolving role: Protecting and defending in the agentic era
items.summary: As AI and agents reshape the enterprise, CISOs face two critical priorities: enabling innovation with the right identity and data guardrails, and modernizing defense to keep pace with AI-powered threats. Aarti Borkar shares how security leaders can approach both.The post The CISO’s evolving role: Protecting and defending in the agentic era appeared first on Microsoft Security Blog.
items.creator: Aarti Borkar
